title: wolfSSL wolfSSL_d2i_SSL_SESSION SESSION_CERTS heap-buffer-overflow
notes: Candidate selected from wolfSSL official security vulnerability entry. Expected root cause: wolfSSL_d2i_SSL_SESSION reads certificate and session id lengths from untrusted serialized session input without sufficient bounds validation when SESSION_CERTS is enabled.
crash_signal: AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow; WRITE of size 4; wolfSSL_d2i_SSL_SESSION src/ssl_sess.c:2831; UBSan index 9 out of bounds for x509_buffer[9]
fixed_behavior: wolfSSL_d2i_SSL_SESSION returned NULL; cleanup completed; NO_ASAN_CRASH_OBSERVED
current_behavior: wolfSSL_d2i_SSL_SESSION returned NULL; cleanup completed; NO_ASAN_CRASH_OBSERVED
reproduction_summary: The PoC creates a valid serialized SSL_SESSION using wolfSSL_i2d_SSL_SESSION, then mutates the SESSION_CERTS chain.count byte to 0xff. In v5.8.4-stable, wolfSSL_d2i_SSL_SESSION trusts the deserialized chain.count and writes beyond the fixed x509_buffer certificate chain array, producing an ASan heap-buffer-overflow and UBSan out-of-bounds index report. In v5.9.0-stable and current, wolfSSL_d2i_SSL_SESSION rejects the oversized chain.count and returns NULL without sanitizer errors.
